ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) distribution; estimated 9:1 ratio of dark pixels to high-intensity white/grey highlights localized at lobe tips and along segments of the trailing edge.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous black/dark-grey regions cover >90% of visible surface. High-contrast white mottling is localized at the distal tips of both lobes. Small intermittent white pixel clusters are observed along the mid-to-outer trailing edge of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression; interior angle approximately 65 degrees; bounding-box depth approximately 15% of total fluke vertical span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-amplitude irregular serrations. Distinct deep notch/indentation located on the left lobe trailing edge approximately 40% distance from the tip. Right lobe displays smaller, higher-frequency serrations with lower pixel amplitude.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex upward sweep on leading edges; trailing edges show a generally concave curve from notch to tip, interrupted by serrations.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clustered high-intensity white pixels (semi-circular) detected at the distal tips of both the left and right lobes, consistent with localized scarring.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant traumatic notch/missing tissue section on the trailing edge of the left lobe, characterized by a sharp inward pixel deviation compared to the symmetrical expectation of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Uniformly dark pigmentation across the central peduncle area and interior lobe surfaces, with white highlights restricted primarily to distal extremities.
